mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.product_id, p.product_code, p.title AS product_title, h.deal_id, h.price, h.currency, h.source_type, h.source_name, h.verification_status, h.recorded_at, h.verified_by, u.display_name AS verifier_name, h.note FROM price_history h JOIN product p ON p.id = h.product_id LEFT JOIN admin_user u ON u.id = h.verified_by WHERE h.id = #{id}
